Code of Conduct

We are committed to a respectful, inclusive, and technically constructive community. Participants should welcome questions asked in good faith, focus criticism on ideas and evidence, respect privacy and data-use restrictions, and acknowledge uncertainty in scientific and technical discussions.

Harassment, discriminatory language, personal attacks, deliberate disclosure of private information, and sustained disruption are unacceptable. Maintainers may edit, remove, or reject contributions and may temporarily or permanently restrict participation when behavior is harmful.

Report conduct concerns privately to the package maintainer at elvin.cordero@seamountgeo.com. Reports will be reviewed as promptly and confidentially as practical. This policy applies in project spaces and when a person is publicly representing the project.

This policy is informed by the Contributor Covenant, version 2.1.

Developed by Elvin Cordero.
